data.note: Acceptance: persistent fixed rules for CO2/temp/humidity/stock/bin/obstruction/noise/tilt/staleness; configurable actions; no LLM in triggers or replenishment interpretation; dedup/recovery, stale/out-of-order rejection, approval intact; connected dashboard config/simulation and opt-in sound; meaningful workflow tests+check/build. Parallel bounded engine and frontend work, root owns API/contracts/integration.
